Spill Area, Slippery Floor. This CAUTION Blower Oil Drum Storage sign from CGAP Safety reads: OIL STORAGE AREA / SLIPPERY IF SPILLED / CLEAN UP DRIPS AT ONCE. Written for wastewater plants, municipal utilities and industrial treatment plants.

Why this sign matters

Prevents slips on spilled oil at the blower room drum storage.

Where to post it

Mount on the wall above the oil drum storage racks.

Who orders it

Wastewater plant operators, utility maintenance supervisors, treatment-system contractors.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards and practice to review for your site: ANSI Z535.4 CAUTION; OSHA 1910.22 walking-working surfaces. A sign supports your site procedures; it does not replace training or supervision.
